scripts.clean:allure: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const p of ['allure-results','allure-report']) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.smoke:android: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "WDIO_MAX_INSTANCES=${WDIO_MAX_INSTANCES:-1} ALLURE_RESULTS_DIR=allure-results/smokePrimary ALLURE_REPORT_DIR=allure-report/smokePrimary PLATFORM=android BROWSERSTACK=true wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts --suite smokePrimary" "WDIO_MAX_INSTANCES=${WDIO_MAX_INSTANCES:-1} ALLURE_RESULTS_DIR=allure-results/smokeSecondary ALLURE_REPORT_DIR=allure-report/smokeSecondary PLATFORM=android BROWSERSTACK=true wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts --suite smokeSecondary"
scripts.allure:report:smoke: npx allure generate allure-results/smokePrimary allure-results/smokeSecondary -o allure-report --clean
